name: Should I keep my bathtub or convert it to a walk-in shower in a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I keep my bathtub or convert it to a walk-in shower in a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion opens up usable floor space and makes compact bathrooms feel significantly larger. Replacing a bulky tub with a curbless or low-threshold walk-in shower creates a continuous visual line across the room, reducing physical barriers. The primary tradeoff involves resale value and household convenience: homes with only one bathroom often benefit from keeping at least one bathtub for small children or pets. If your home has another tub elsewhere, converting a small secondary bathroom into a walk-in shower is an effective way to maximize daily comfort, light, and accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting to a walk-in shower maximizes space and accessibility, but keeping a tub is recommended if it is the only bathtub in the home.
